D: Kermit and the gang go to New York to put on a Broadway show.
P: Serve dessert at Kermit and Piggy's wedding.
S: the Greek diner where they wait tables
Hand-cut chips double-fried, tossed while hot with dried oregano, lemon zest and crumbled feta, Greek diner style.
Grilled cheese sandwiches with cheddar and a little Dijon, griddled in butter, cut into soldiers.
he's a bear, he needs supplies
Mixed nuts tossed in honey and cinnamon, roasted at 170C for 12 minutes, stirred as they cool, mixed with dried apricots.
M: Three slices of toast: turkey, bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo, pinned and cut into triangles, chips on the side.
big tomato, big olives, very Pete
Chunky tomato, cucumber, red onion, green capsicum, kalamata olives and a slab of feta with oregano and good olive oil.
W: the wedding that might be real
Two layers of vanilla butter cake sandwiched and covered in Swiss meringue buttercream, half tinted pink and half green, piped flowers.
K: Drip coffee in diner mugs, cream and sugar on the counter.

s.note: the Greek diner where they wait tables
s.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into chips and fry twice, first at 140C, then at 185C. Toss while hot with 1 tsp dried oregano, the zest of a lemon, salt and 100g crumbled feta. Squeeze the lemon over just before serving.

Spread 8 slices white bread with Dijon and fill with 200g sliced cheddar. Butter the outsides with 40g butter and griddle over medium heat for 3 minutes a side until golden and melted. Cut into soldiers.

m.how: Grill 8 rashers of bacon. Toast 12 slices bread. Layer 300g sliced turkey, bacon, lettuce and 2 sliced tomatoes with mayo across three slices for each sandwich. Pin with toothpicks and cut into triangles. Serve with potato chips.

w.note: the wedding that might be real
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour. Bake in two tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Beat 250g butter with 400g icing sugar, split and tint half pink and half green. Ice and pipe flowers.

d.how: Brew 60g ground coffee with 1L water in a drip machine and keep it on the hot plate. Pour into thick diner mugs and leave a jug of milk and the sugar on the counter so everyone fixes their own.
